methodology.network: Loopback HTTP in a network-none container; synthetic page, no production access.
methodology.compression: Timed responses use identity encoding; files stay gzip-compressed. Gzip HTTP replay is checked separately. DisableOutputCompression avoids double encoding by the native file cache and OutputHandler.
methodology.baseline: Actual MediaWiki, MobileFrontend and Minerva; parser cache warm; 31 sequential requests.
methodology.prototype: Separate mobile HTML file directory; lab-only Article subclass; 31 sequential hits.
methodology.limits: No SMW/site templates, physical device, real network or multi-user concurrency benchmark.
